patterns.usage_note: Marks the far edge of a stretch — of time, distance or degree — that the action continues over, and it pairs naturally with から for the near edge. Contrast 〜までに, which names a deadline for a one-shot action (五時までに出す "hand it in by five"), and the additive まで meaning "even", which belongs to a different pattern.

examples.ruby: 駅[えき]から公園[こうえん]までゆっくり歩[ある]いた。
examples.english: We strolled all the way from the station to the park.

examples.ruby: この図書館[としょかん]は夜[よる]九時[くじ]まで利用[りよう]できる。
examples.english: This library is open for use until nine at night.

examples.ruby: 彼[かれ]はコップの底[そこ]まで一気[いっき]に飲[の]み干[ほ]した。
examples.english: He drained the glass in one go, right down to the bottom.
